changes.comment: `EditTxn.deleteElements` is now all-or-nothing: if any element in the expanded delete set is still referenced from outside the set, nothing is deleted and the status is `ConstraintViolation`. `BulkDeleteElementsStatus.PartialSuccess` has been removed. `BulkDeleteElementsResult.failures` reports each blocking element with a `BulkDeleteFailureReason`. Deprecated `skipFKConstraintValidations` (now ignored) and `failedIds`.
